slides.heading: Building a Formatted Output
slides.body: Building a Formatted Output is part of Mathematical and String Operations. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Building a Formatted Output
slides.body: Formatted output arranges text and values clearly. It helps users understand results, receipts, and short reports.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Formatted output is like designing a clean menu board where each item and price is easy to read.
